source_snapshot.procedure: Fully populate and perform 100 AC cycles.
source_snapshot.criteria: No errors, hang or lost device.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; adds inventory, fixture/timing, per-cycle proof, low-rail/dew-point and recovery.

old_problem: Pending values were inventory, fixture/dwells/readiness, event oracle and environmental limits.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits runtime bindings, ED-06 preserves AC-cycle identity, ED-09 keeps physical power/chamber work manual, ED-17 preserves logs, and ED-18 requires OFF→ON→OS-ready proof for every cycle.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row60 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3094 and actual next row61/history3095 were read.
A rated interlocked fixture, true-off/discharge/on dwell and complete inventory define each of exactly 100 cycles.
Per-cycle readiness, inventory and events prevent a final healthy boot from masking intermittent low-rail initialization loss.
Dew-point, rail undershoot, OOB abort and dry restoration are mandatory; no cycle ran.

test_case.test_name: Fully populated system 100 AC cycles at 0C/-5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify all populated devices/services recover through 100 complete AC OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready cycles at cold/low-rail margin.
required_package: Rated AC fixture and dwell/readiness profile
Per-cycle event/device oracle and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/-5% conditions and execute exactly 100 approved fixture cycles, proving true off/discharge, reapplication, POST/BMC/OS readiness and complete inventory each time, then warm dry and restore nominal state.
test_case.expected_result: All 100 cycles meet power-state/readiness deadlines with complete inventory and expected-only events, followed by healthy restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires 100 distinct OFF→ON→OS-ready ledgers; final boot only, DC reset, warm reboot or a retried failure cannot pass.
safety_gate: Abort on electrical, moisture, boot or device fault
Preserve logs; no auto-retry; dry warm-up
test_case.recovery: Stop on the first disallowed fault, preserve its cycle evidence, isolate power safely, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, recover devices/services and do not retry.

blocked.reason: Safe manual cycle contract is parameterized.
